items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: Yeah, played with Depp and somebody else.

ctx.x: Yeah, played with Depp and somebody else. I can't think who the other -- somebody else's band, and probably a couple of others, but he was out in front of us, so we didn't know where he was. But he lives over in Jersey. He's been working for one of the distillers, Brown and Forman Distillers, out of Kentucky, but he lives in Jersey, has his
own home there. And he don't play anything now, but he was a wonderful bass horn player. Played the double-B, too, didn't play E-Flat.
